name: Quote calculator submits customer details to Formspree
description: Verifies quote details are submitted to the configured Formspree endpoint without opening the visitor's email application.
steps: Open Get a Quote
Choose a service, service option, add-ons, and quantity
Enter a valid name and email address
Submit the quote request
Verify the form displays a success confirmation after a successful response
expected: The browser sends the selected service, options, add-ons, quantity, estimate, and customer contact details to the configured Formspree form. A success confirmation appears in place without navigating away; failed submissions display an error and allow retry.

name: Quote form handles a failed Formspree submission
description: Checks that a failed request does not falsely tell the customer their quote was sent.
steps: Open the quote form on a mobile viewport
Enter valid customer details
Simulate a Formspree submission failure
Submit the form
expected: The form shows an error message, does not clear the entered customer details, and allows the customer to retry.

name: Browse the updated site on mobile
description: Checks that the existing visual design and new calculator fit a narrow screen.
steps: Open the homepage at a mobile viewport
Open the menu and select Get a quote
Select a service and toggle an add-on
Scroll through customer fields
expected: Navigation works, logo is visible, calculator controls fit without horizontal overflow, and the quote summary remains readable.

name: Branded not found page and favicon
description: Checks the branded 404 page and favicon metadata.
steps: Open /404.html
Review the logo and not-found message
Use Back to home
expected: The custom 404 page loads, uses the Rockaway logo favicon and returns to the homepage.

name: Compare work photos and open the customer review contact
description: Verifies visitors can compare project photos on a phone and can contact the business to share feedback.
steps: Open Our Work on a mobile viewport
Drag the Fall Cleanup before-and-after slider from left to right
Confirm the reveal position changes and both labels remain visible
Open Reviews and select Share your feedback
expected: The image reveal responds to touch and pointer input without horizontal page scrolling. The Reviews section explains how to share feedback and opens an email addressed to the business.
